$comment: RinOS builds bypass vcpkg entirely. All external dependencies are either:
1) Replaced by RinOS-native implementations (rintls, rinicu, aquamarine)
2) Self-built from vendored sources in libs/ (FFmpeg, zlib, png, jpeg, webp, sqlite3)
3) Excluded from the feature set (Skia, ANGLE, AVIF, JXL, WOFF2)
4) Provided by Ladybird's own code (LibXML parser, UnsignedBigInteger)
5) Kept as vcpkg deps for non-RinOS platforms (fast-float, fmt, simdutf)
CMake guard: host package discovery is bypassed for RinOS; FFmpeg uses RINOS_FFMPEG_ROOT imported targets.
Build path: Meson builds the locked LGPL FFmpeg configuration before Ladybird and passes an architecture-specific prefix.
See: Documentation/RinOS_Porting.md for the full dependency replacement table.

rinos-dependency-map.ffmpeg: → libs/FFmpeg static LGPL build (media=on; decode/custom I/O only)
